draft.shortGloss: to remember; to keep in mind
draft.emotion: thoughtful and reminiscent, reaching back into the past
notes: Describes the state of holding something in memory. For the act of suddenly recalling something, use вспомнить.
Takes a direct object in the accusative case (помнить имя) or о + prepositional case (помнить о встрече).
